title: 第三章 寻踪第四章 读书第五章 猎踪
content_zh:
卧牛山离县城不远，周边又有好几个贫困的村子。这就导致外面这一圈，连野菜都刨的干干净净，更别说猎物了。
李尚文转了一个上午，连个毛也没碰上。他有些颓废的坐在路边的大石头上，调息恢复。
看来这打猎，也不是那么轻松的。
咕咕～
几只野生的鸽子在空中飞过。
李尚文惊喜的睁开眼，抽箭搭弓，嘣的一声，箭矢离弦。
可惜，这却不似院子里的固定靶，第一箭直接落空。
那鸽子似嘲讽他一般，落在不远处的地上，一蹦一跳的。
李尚文也不气馁，再抽一支箭，屏息凝神，嘣的一声弓弦，箭矢插入了松软的泥地里。
鸽子被这一惊，彻底的飞远了。
没想到前世钓鱼空军，到了这辈子，打猎也是空军。
李尚文走过去，将两支箭矢捡回来，继续在山上转悠。本来一个合格的猎户，还要有猎犬，捕兽夹这些工具辅助。
但李尚文如今家徒四壁，只剩手里这张弓了。
他努力回想着，父亲之前是如何寻找猎物的。粪便，气味，脚印……
想着想着，面板又浮现了出来。
【寻踪（未入门1%）】
“这也算技艺？”李尚文愣了一下，人间百艺，三教九流，他能学的，还有很多很多。
又搜寻了半日，李尚文也只收获了几棵野菜。
日薄西山，将卧牛山映的黄灿灿的。
李尚文坐下来调息，打算回去了。这一天也并非毫无收获，寻踪从未入门进阶到了入门。

技艺的提升，入门是最快的。
霎时间，眼前的山坡变得更加清晰，四周细微的虫鸣也清楚可辨，泥土的腥味混合着树叶腐败的味道钻入他的鼻腔，层次分明。
这是【寻踪】入门带给他的改变。
李尚文闭目，鼻翼微动，嗅到了一股不同寻常的味道。
那是新鲜粪便的气味。
李尚文循着味，来到了一处小坡前。在杂草隐蔽之处，一只野兔正趴在那里，忘我的啃着干草。
深吸一口气，李尚文屏住呼吸，开弓架箭。
此刻天光有些晦暗，但却不影响他瞄准，昨夜月光下的练习，化作此刻的箭锋！
嘣！
弓弦铮鸣，野兔跳起。
然终究没有逃过厄运，被一箭对穿，落在了杂草之中。
中了！
李尚文大喜，这是他人生中第一个猎物，今天没白来啊。
跑过去将野兔和都捡回来，李尚文高高兴兴的下山去了。
他没有着急回家，而是又去了一趟集市，用剩下的一百文钱，买了些大米和咸菜，这才往村子里赶。
一路上，随着他腰间肥美兔子的晃动，引来了不少火热的目光。但看到他背上背的长弓，又挪开了视线。
来到离家不远的地方，李尚文突然听到隔壁巷道里传来异样的声音。
“刘癞子，你放开我，再这样我可要喊人了”
嫂嫂！
content_en:
Woniu Mountain is not far from the county seat, and there are several poor villages around it. This resulted in that in the area outside, even the wild vegetables were dug clean, let alone the prey.
Li Shangwen walked around all morning and didn't even encounter a hair. He sat on the big stone on the roadside a little decadently, adjusting his breath and recovering.
It seems that hunting is not that easy.
Gugu~
A few wild pigeons flew through the air.
Li Shangwen opened his eyes in surprise, drew an arrow and nocked the bow, and with a bang, the arrow left the string.
Unfortunately, this is not like a fixed target in the yard, and the first arrow misses directly.
The pigeon seemed to be taunting him, landing on the ground not far away, jumping up and down.
Li Shangwen was not discouraged. He drew another arrow, held his breath and concentrated. With a bang, the arrow inserted into the soft mud.
The pigeon was shocked by this and flew away completely.
Unexpectedly, in my previous life, I was an Air Force fisherman, but in this life, I am also an Air Force hunter.
Li Shangwen walked over, picked up the two arrows, and continued to wander around the mountain. Originally, a qualified hunter also needed tools such as hunting dogs and bear traps to assist him.
But Li Shangwen's family is now in ruins, and all he has left is the bow in his hand.
He tried to remember how his father found prey before. Feces, smell, footprints...
After thinking about it, the panel appeared again.
[Track (1% not yet started)]
"Is this considered a skill?" Li Shangwen was stunned for a moment. There are hundreds of arts in the world, and there are many more that he can learn.
After searching for another half day, Li Shangwen only harvested a few wild vegetables.
As the sun sets over the western mountains, Woniu Mountain is reflected in a brilliant yellow color.
Li Shangwen sat down to adjust his breathing and planned to go back. This day was not without gain, as Xunzong advanced from beginner to beginner.
The fastest way to improve your skills is to get started.
In an instant, the hillside in front of him became clearer, and the subtle chirping of insects around him was clearly distinguishable. The fishy smell of earth mixed with the smell of rotting leaves penetrated his nostrils with distinct layers.
This is the change that the introduction of [Tracing] brought to him.
Li Shangwen closed his eyes, his nose moved slightly, and he smelled an unusual smell.
It was the smell of fresh feces.
Li Shangwen followed the smell and came to a small slope. In the hidden place of the weeds, a hare was lying there, gnawing on the hay selflessly.
Taking a deep breath, Li Shangwen held his breath and fired his bow.
The skylight was a little dim at the moment, but it did not affect his aim. The practice under the moonlight last night turned into the arrow edge at this moment!
Boom!
The bow strings clang and the hare jumps up.
However, he did not escape the bad luck after all. He was pierced by an arrow and fell into the weeds.
Hit!
Li Shangwen was overjoyed. This was his first prey in his life. Today was not in vain.
After running over to pick up the hare and the rabbit, Li Shangwen went down the mountain happily.
He was not in a hurry to go home, but went to the market again, used the remaining one hundred pence to buy some rice and pickles, and then rushed to the village.
Along the way, as the plump rabbit swayed around his waist, he attracted many fiery glances. But when he saw the long bow on his back, he looked away again.
Arriving not far from home, Li Shangwen suddenly heard a strange sound coming from the alley next door.
"Liu Lezi, let me go. If you do this again, I will call someone."
Sister-in-law!
